notes.title: Update 1.4 The Path to Death
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36428730/cbbf86c9b68630670ff9f6cda86ba0f13da3c6bc.png[/img]
Almost everything has been changed in this update. The entire list of changes due to its size will not be given, [b]I will emphasize only the main points:[/b]

[list]
[*] New interface, clear and simple
[*] More enemies
[*] Changed characteristics of both the hero and opponents
[*] Updated, and somewhere redrawn objects on locations
[*] New game menu and logo
[*] New statistics after the death of the main character with a description of all the artifacts
[*] Countless different fixes and improvements.
[/list]

I have some more ideas for updates Underneath. [b]I would really like to hear feedback from you:)[/b]
Sincerely,
[i]Nikolay[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.3.1. New controller and quality of life
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36428730/d5adbfdf6a3b55b278fc8942746b98155284e15a.png[/img]

[b]What's new: [/b]

[list]
[*]Highlighting buttons in the main menu
[*]Minor changes to the main menu
[*][u]New system of transition to the next floor.[/u] ([i]Now the camera shows the future level, after which the hero begins to fall on the map [/i])
[*]the camera is now closer and centered on the main character, now he will always be in the center of the screen
[*]Control on [b]WASD[/b], abilities on 1-2-3-4
[/list]

[b]Changes and corrections:[/b]

[list]
[*]Opponents [b]no longer attack or move [/b] until the hero falls to the floor
[*]The traces of slime are gradually disappearing
[*]lava touches are no longer processed every millisecond
[*] The background has become slightly darker
[*]The overall rate adjusted
[/list]

in the future, there will be several more updates that add new features that simplify the interaction with the game.

notes.title: New biome and bug fixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36428730/bef795e669d93073f3f3754491b707b21bd91926.png[/img]
[b]Underneath [/b] updated to version [b] 1.2.5 [/b]. The errors from the previous update have been fixed. Arena now works as it should. Also, I continue to gradually change the appearance of the interface for the better.

[list]
[*] [b] Changes: [/b]
[*] New biome [b] Deadlands [/b] - lava, grass and exclusively opponents of ranged combat. Available only in arena mode.
[*] New death window interface.
[*] Artifacts in arena mode are now unique. There will no longer be 4 identical artifacts.
[*] Now opponents fly away from blows even more strongly. Feel the power of the mace of Darius.
[*] [b] The shield (ability E) now allows you to repel ranged shells. [/b]
[*] Enemies no longer appear in the store in the arena.
[/list]

Thanks for playing
Norska Nikolay

notes.title: Underneath huge update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36428730/d9a5dc2470763069a3db528157cc3900bcfc7114.png[/img]
Hello everyone! After a little lull, we are releasing a new update with many fixes and improvements!
[list]
[*] [b] List of changes: [/b]
[*] 1) The gameplay has become faster
[*] 2) Fire trail of Necromancer shells
[*] 3) Necromancer can now summon more skeletons
[*] 4) There was a chance to inflict critical damage
[*] 5) Player damage sounds
[*] 6) The camera has become a little closer to the player
[*] 7) The amount of health of the skeleton mini boss has decreased
[*] 8) Now the number of opponents has become more
[*] 9) The skeleton archer firing arrows of fire also leaves a mark on them
[*] 10) The total amount of player health in the arena has increased to 4
[*] 11) Now when playing in the arena at the beginning of the round random artifacts are issued
[*] 12) Some visual elements changed
[/list]

Also soon a big discount on Underneath will start! Stay with us :-)
[b] Norska Nikolay [/b]

notes.title: First update after release
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback and comments about the game!

[b]Changes: [/b]
[list]

[*] 2) the Start screen with the control does not disappear immediately.
[*] 3) Developer Features are disabled.
[/list]

Some bugs have also been fixed!
